name: AutoWiFi BITS
one_line: Automatically and silently logs BITS Pilani students into the campus FortiGate Wi-Fi captive portal in the background when joining campus Wi-Fi or when sessions expire.
users: BITS Pilani students using their own campus ID and password

features.name: Captive portal detection and FortiGate login
features.detail: Check http://neverssl.com (fallback http://connectivitycheck.gstatic.com/generate_204); if redirected or served a 200 page containing https://fw.bits-pilani.ac.in:8090/fgtauth?<magic>, POST configurable form fields (default username, password, magic, 4Tredir). Do nothing if already logged in or if fw.bits-pilani.ac.in does not resolve.

features.name: Keepalive and session refresh
features.detail: Extract the keepalive URL (https://fw.bits-pilani.ac.in:8090/keepalive?<token>) after successful login and call it every 5 minutes; trigger a fresh login if keepalive fails.

features.name: Retry backoff and quiet failure notifications
features.detail: Retry failed checks or logins at 5s, 15s, 60s, then every 5 minutes while the portal is showing. Send at most one quiet notification per hour (never on success) when credentials are rejected (stop retrying until updated), after 3 consecutive non-credential login failures, or if the portal form changes.

features.name: Secure OS credential storage
features.detail: Store campus ID and password only in macOS Keychain, Windows Credential Manager, Android Keystore, or Linux Secret Service (via go-keyring, with ~/.config/autowifi-bits/credentials mode 600 fallback and one-time warning). Never store credentials in code, logs, repo, or download page.

features.name: macOS background agent
features.detail: Single Go binary for macOS 12+ running in the background with no windows, optional menu-bar icon, and start-at-login support.

features.name: Windows background app
features.detail: Single Go binary for Windows 10+ with system tray icon and start-at-login support.

features.name: Android background app
features.detail: Kotlin app for Android 8.0+ (API 26+) triggering checks on Wi-Fi connect via ConnectivityManager.NetworkCallback plus a 15-minute WorkManager periodic check, with a one-time battery-optimization exemption request.

features.name: iOS Apple Shortcuts automation and guide
features.detail: Apple Shortcuts automation triggered when joining BITS Wi-Fi SSIDs with on-device Text actions for credentials and setup instructions advising iCloud Advanced Data Protection.

features.name: TLS verification and host-only pinning
features.detail: Verify the *.bits-pilani.ac.in certificate on port 8090 against the standard OS trust store first, falling back to pinning fw.bits-pilani.ac.in only if verification fails on an OS; never disable TLS verification globally.

features.name: Shared protocol spec, JSON test cases, and local mock portal
features.detail: One written protocol spec and shared JSON test cases executed by both Go and Kotlin implementations against a local mock FortiGate portal issuing per-visit magic tokens, keepalive, and logout URLs.

features.name: Capture diagnostic command
features.detail: Diagnostic command that prints the captive portal form action URL and input field names (never values) when the portal is showing, with configurable field names.

features.name: GitHub Releases and static download page
features.detail: Distribute binaries and APK via GitHub Releases and a static GitHub Pages download site documenting Gatekeeper, SmartScreen, and Android sideload steps.

features.name: Linux desktop support
features.detail: Go single binary for Ubuntu 22.04+ with tray icon, start at login, and Secret Service or mode-600 file credential storage.

features.name: Manual login trigger
features.detail: Provide a Log in now button or menu action to trigger an immediate portal check and login.

features.name: Auto-update check
features.detail: Periodically check GitHub Releases for newer versions.

features.name: Code signing and notarization
features.detail: Sign Windows binaries and sign/notarize macOS binaries in a future release.

user_flows: Onboarding: Student downloads the installer/APK or Apple Shortcut from the static GitHub Pages site, follows OS trust prompts (Gatekeeper/SmartScreen/Android install permission), and saves their campus ID and password into the OS secure store (or Shortcut Text actions on iOS).

Automatic background login: Device connects to campus Wi-Fi or an existing session expires; the app checks neverssl.com (or gstatic generate_204), detects redirect to fw.bits-pilani.ac.in:8090/fgtauth?<magic>, submits the login POST, and stores the returned keepalive URL silently without notifying.
Already logged in or off-campus: Check returns normal 200/204 without fgtauth, or fw.bits-pilani.ac.in fails DNS resolution; the app does nothing.
Session keepalive: Every 5 minutes after login, the app requests the keepalive URL; if keepalive fails, it triggers a fresh captive portal check and login.

Failure and backoff: On wrong credentials, the app sends one quiet notification and pauses retries until the user updates credentials; on network or portal errors, it retries at 5s, 15s, 60s, and 5m intervals, notifying quietly once per hour after 3 consecutive failures or unexpected portal form changes.
Campus diagnostic capture: Student runs the capture command while the portal is visible to print the form action URL and field names for confirmation.
integrations: macOS Keychain, Windows Credential Manager, Linux Secret Service API, Android Keystore

stack.language: Go (macOS 12+, Windows 10+, Ubuntu 22.04+), Kotlin (Android 8.0+ / API 26+), Apple Shortcuts (iOS)
stack.framework: Go single cross-compiled desktop binary with system tray and auto-start; Native Android SDK
stack.database: None (OS secure credential stores only; mode-600 file fallback on Linux)

non_goals: Any backend server, database, user accounts, or hosted web app
Storing credentials in source code, logs, repository, or download page
Building a background login app for iOS
Depending on Wi-Fi SSID detection on desktop or Android
Code signing and notarization in the first release
open_questions: What are the exact BITS Pilani Wi-Fi SSID names from iPhone Wi-Fi settings needed for the Apple Shortcuts automation trigger?
What are the exact FortiGate portal form action URL, input field names, and keepalive/logout URL formats captured on campus Wi-Fi?
Does the fw.bits-pilani.ac.in:8090 TLS certificate validate against standard OS trust stores on macOS, Windows, Ubuntu, and Android, or is a pinned host certificate needed?
What exact 4Tredir value does the campus portal expect, and what exact HTTP status or response body text distinguishes rejected credentials from transient portal errors?
